The primary subject in the foreground is a Blenheim (white with chestnut markings) spaniel facing the camera, exhibiting characteristic long ears and feathering. A second dog, a Tricolor (black, white, and tan) spaniel wearing a blue harness, stands in the background to the right. The setting appears to be an outdoor patio or deck with wooden planks.
